slices.title: define-executable-motif-program-types
slices.summary: Defined and publicly exported the sealed renderer-neutral ExecutableSuccessorMotifProgram draft/verified union for operation evaluation, identity fission, and identity fusion. Exact tuple types fix phase order/effects; variant-specific roles and lineage, context, accessibility, reduced motion, continuity, and rewind obligations are typed. Negative fixtures reject caller timing, paths, notation/DOM, phase reorder, cross-variant fields, and fabricated authority within inference budget.

slices.title: mint-verified-motif-programs
slices.summary: Added the sole trusted runtime validator and mint for all three executable successor motif program variants. Exact schemas enforce exhaustive phase order/effects, total canonical roles, legal lineage cardinality, context preservation, accessibility, reduced motion, exact rewind, continuity, and pinned versions; WeakSet authority is immutable and non-serializable, while DOM, notation, geometry, paths, pixels, opacity, handoff, and timing are rejected without inspecting rendered glyph text.

slices.title: evolve-presentation-registry-program-route
slices.summary: Evolved the operation-evaluation registry and resolved certificate to v4. Every supported core or extension entry now pins the sole minted operation-evaluation executable-program compiler beside its verified plan and continuity compilers; pack and compiler drift fail closed, extensions cannot inject or replace program semantics, and unsupported routes remain explicit static checkpoints.

slices.title: require-program-in-reader-plans
slices.summary: Made the reader successor-synthesis plan variant require one verified minted operation-evaluation program and removed its independent optional visual-motif label. The sole reader mint rejects missing, label-only, forged, and non-evaluation program authority; parallel cohorts require one shared program object, compilation propagates the registry-minted program, and static unsupported routes remain unchanged.

slices.title: add-exhaustive-program-adapter
slices.summary: Added one exhaustive executable-program adapter over the three sealed program variants. Operation evaluation feeds the existing native successor-synthesis intents; identity fission and fusion feed the existing fission/fusion primitive. The reader still owns exactly one native compositor session while exposing immutable program ID, version, kind, forward/rewind phase order, and deterministic sampled phase telemetry. No new renderer, lifecycle, scheduler, clock, geometry, timing, or path category was introduced; wide, phone, cross-browser, production, budget, and exact-fraction preservation gates pass.

slices.title: gate-label-execution-honesty
slices.summary: Added a nominal, exhaustive execution-route gate and an unforgeable executable-motif promotion certificate. Fresh catalog reports now distinguish verified operation/program routes, explicit static checkpoints, and generic visual/default labels; 24 pre-existing generic transformations are truthfully incomplete rather than falsely verified. Operation evaluation and exact fraction remain partial until exact program/route, phase-role, perceptual continuity, endpoint, browser, and human evidence exists. Copied JSON, labels, generic routes, unsafe casts, stale reports, and program-route drift cannot mint verified-animated or ported status. Three explicitly allowlisted pre-program exemplars retain their reviewed historical status; no new animation can use that exemption.

slices.title: define-perceptual-continuity-contract
slices.summary: Added one nominal renderer-neutral perceptual-continuity contract bound to the exact minted executable motif program. It fixes motif visible-ink floors, intentional-vanish authority, normalized adjacent geometry and raster budgets, total unambiguous atomic ownership, exact native source and target paint metrics, and a bounded 72-trace direction/seek/replay/browser/viewport/DPR evidence matrix. Program roles and lineage remain semantic truth; measurements are current-frame evidence only and raster history can never author semantics. Runtime and compile-time adversarial cases reject renderer topology, DOM, pixel-history authority, copied contracts, program drift, blank paint, jumps, ownership gaps, endpoint drift, and phase drift.

slices.title: select-continuity-topology
slices.summary: Selected bounded semantic-contact co-presence for many-to-one operation evaluation from a closed three-candidate comparison against the approved continuous-recognition reference. Six 101-frame browser/viewport paint profiles satisfy the s11 contract with exact endpoints; reverse FLIP remains limited to compatible one-to-one paint and visible carrier remains a bounded fallback. This slice changes diagnostic and architectural authority only, not production rendering.

slices.title: compile-continuity-under-motif-phases
slices.summary: Added one nominal program-continuity compiler with a closed compatibility matrix for operation evaluation, identity fission, and identity fusion. It derives phase-bound continuity obligations and exact rewind solely from the minted executable program, retains the exact perceptual contract, exposes no renderer authority, rejects cross-family topology reuse and copied authority, and makes the legacy shared-zero-area topology un-compilable for every current program because intentional vanish is forbidden.

slices.title: extend-successor-endpoint-microscope
slices.summary: Added exact identity-correlated successor endpoint telemetry and a development-only microscope spanning 1-epsilon, native target, and post-settlement. Non-path successor paint now carries measured native target ink geometry; clone measurement is isolated from its own motion transform; target pose dwells exactly from 0.99 through handoff. Twelve cross-browser viewport DPR profiles pass paint baseline inset style font rule silhouette raster owner and exact post-settlement checks, with radical and fraction neighbors preserved and no notation- or browser-specific offsets.

slices.title: restore-one-plus-two-evaluation
slices.summary: Restored 1 + 2 to 3 through the registry-minted operation-evaluation program and selected bounded semantic-contact co-presence topology. One shared pure opaque-gather-and-recognize sampler now drives the approved reference and canonical native renderer; material inputs remain opaque through recognition, catalysts have evaluation-only contact authority, and the measured target settles exactly without caller geometry, timing, numeral, notation, or browser branches. All 167 operation contracts and the 45-case three-browser wide/phone/DPR matrix pass; the candidate remains unpromoted pending slice-16 human approval.

slices.title: human-evaluation-program-checkpoint
slices.summary: Human-approved the production-primary executable 1 + 2 to 3 checkpoint in the existing Animation Library. The accepted runtime preserves opaque contributor gathering, geometric co-presence, exact native endpoints, stable typography, shared seek/rewind/replay behavior, wide/phone containment, and one Review owner across the 45-case three-browser matrix. The frozen reference remains diagnostic only; approval unlocks unchanged-program caller generalization.

slices.title: generalize-five-plus-two
slices.summary: Registered 5 + 2 to 7 as a semantic id/left/right caller of the existing constant-sum compiler. It resolves the same nominal executable program and continuity object as 1 + 2, loads through the same lazy adapter, retains three opaque moving contributors, and settles at native 7 without numeral, geometry, timing, opacity, path, or scheduler authority.

slices.title: generalize-fraction-quotient
slices.summary: Compiled 3/6 to 1/2 through the unchanged nominal operation-evaluation program, continuity contract, compiler, and surface adapter. The native source fraction rule is one catalyst paint atom excluded from material lineage, while the target rule inherits the single semantic result owner. Six three-browser wide/phone checks prove opaque ink, structural-rule geometry, exact rewind, and absence of cancellation or fraction-specific motion.
